content.value: Consider the generator matrix G for an $( n , k , d , N _ { d } )$ linear block code given below:
i) Specify the values of code parameters n, $k , d ,$ and $N _ { d } .$

ii) Assume that the uncoded binary PAM system has the error probability $\mathcal { Q } \Bigg ( \sqrt { \frac { 2  { E _ { b } } } { N _ { v } } } \Bigg )$ , where $E _ { b }$ is the energy per bit and $N _ { \theta } \dot { / } 2$ is the noise PSD. Find
the Union bound estimate for the error probability per bit Pb in term of $E _ { b } / N _ { \theta }$ for the above code.
ii)  Compute the coding gain (in dB) for this block code at $\rho _ { b } { = } 1 0 ^ { - 6 }$
Note: for numerical computation, you may find some of the following useful equations:

$$
\mathcal { Q } \Bigg ( \sqrt { \frac { 2 \overline { { E _ { h } } } } { N _ { o } } } \Bigg ) = 1 0 ^ { - 6 } \Rightarrow \frac { E _ { h } } { N _ { o } } \cong 1 0 . 5 \mathrm { d B } . ,
$$

$$
\frac { 1 } { 3 } { \mathcal Q } \left( \sqrt { \frac { 2 4 E _ { b } } { 7 N _ { o } } } \right) = 1 0 ^ { - 6 } \Rightarrow \frac { E _ { h } } { N _ { o } } \cong 9 . 1 \overset { \cdot } { \mathrm { d B } } ,
$$
